name: maps
title: Linkage maps — the core observation table
description: One row per linkage map from one study. A species with several published maps has several rows. Stores what was measured; the recombination rate is NOT stored here — it is derived in recombination_rates.csv from map_length_cM / genome_size_mb. Records that fail the 2017 inclusion criteria are retained and flagged rather than deleted.

fields.name: map_id
fields.description: Stable record identifier, RM + 4 digits. Never reused.

fields.name: ott_id
fields.description: Open Tree taxon id. Joins to species.csv.

fields.name: species_name
fields.description: Species name. Joins to species.csv.

fields.name: ref_id
fields.description: Source publication. Joins to references.csv. Null for records added after the 2017 paper whose reference is not yet supplied.

fields.name: map_length_cM
fields.description: Total map length in centimorgans, summed over all linkage groups.

fields.name: map_sex
fields.description: Which map this length refers to.

fields.name: map_length_female_cM
fields.description: Female map length, where reported separately.

fields.name: map_length_male_cM
fields.description: Male map length, where reported separately.

fields.name: n_markers
fields.description: Number of mapped markers.

fields.name: n_linkage_groups
fields.description: Number of linkage groups recovered.

fields.name: haploid_chromosome_number
fields.description: Haploid chromosome number (n) for the species.

fields.name: mapping_population_n
fields.description: Number of individuals in the mapping population.

fields.name: genome_size_mb
fields.description: Genome size in Mb used for this record. Joins via genome_size_id to the full estimate record.

fields.name: genome_size_id
fields.description: Which genome-size estimate was used. Joins to genome_sizes.csv.

fields.name: genome_size_method
fields.description: How that estimate was obtained.

fields.name: map_length_extrapolated_cM
fields.description: Extrapolated map length carried in the source compilation. Retained for comparison; not used in derived rates.

fields.name: rate_as_published_cM_per_Mb
fields.description: Rate as printed in the source study, where the compilation recorded one. Retained for comparison ONLY — use recombination_rates.csv.

fields.name: qc_few_markers
fields.description: TRUE where fewer than 50 markers were mapped (a 2017 exclusion criterion).

fields.name: qc_lg_hcn_mismatch
fields.description: TRUE where |linkage groups - haploid chromosome number| / haploid chromosome number > 0.7 (a 2017 exclusion criterion).

fields.name: qc_duplicate_of_other_record
fields.description: TRUE where this row duplicates another row in this table (same map re-reported in a later compilation).

fields.name: passes_2017_criteria
fields.description: TRUE where the record meets both 2017 inclusion criteria. Null where a required field is missing. Set this filter to reproduce the published analysis.

fields.name: in_published_353
fields.description: TRUE where this record appears in the published 353-species supplement.

fields.name: from_corbett_detig_2015
fields.description: TRUE where the compilation recorded the value as taken from Corbett-Detig et al. 2015 rather than the primary study.

fields.name: needs_reference
fields.description: TRUE where no reference has been supplied yet. These are the priority for curation.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: Row number in the original LinkageMapIinfo2.csv. Provenance anchor.

fields.name: source_first_author
fields.description: First-author surname as recorded in the compilation.

fields.name: source_year
fields.description: Year as recorded in the compilation.
